notes.title: The Hydra - Update 2
notes.content:
Greetings Incarnates,

We’re super excited for today’s Update, as we’ve got a new Artefact, the Soul Drain Catalyst, and a Boss, the Hydra, coming to ASCENDANTS Rising!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275583/3a9e42b2ac9c26e92cda9e9df892764caaa897fc.png[/img]
[h1]Soul Drain Catalyst:[/h1]

The Soul Drain Catalyst is ideal for players who know how to read the battlefield as the action unfolds.

Being a channeling ability, Soul Drain boosts the damage this weapon inflicts and the mana it creates the longer this Artefact is utilized.

Soul Drain also boasts a powerful signature ability, Giga Drain, which lets you cast a mightier version of the ability for 2 seconds. If you can control this ability for its entire phase, this will result in the Artefact generating a tremendous amount of damage and mana.

[h1]The Hydra:[/h1]

The Hydra bursts onto the scene, and it’s ready to annihilate you!

This Boss takes the old saying, “Two heads are better than one,” to a whole other level.

When players engage the Hydra, they will be confronted with a Boss featuring two heads. However, for each head you cut off this creature, two more heads will sprout from this Boss’s body.

It’s up to you and your fellow Incarnates to continue to engage the Hydra until it cannot spawn new heads.

[list]
[*] [h3]Draining Waters[/h3]
Launch a bolt that deals[b] 500 damage[/b] and applies one stack of [b]Draining Waters[/b] to the Protector. 

[b]Draining Waters:[/b] Deals [b]6000 damage[/b] over [b]20 seconds[/b].

Grants the Expunge ability. [b]Expunge"Shift+LMB":[/b] Remove [b]1 stacks of Draining Waters[/b] and creates a [b]15-meter[/b] zone that deals [b]300 000 damage[/b] over [b]300 seconds[/b].
[*] [h3]Cursed Water[/h3]
Creates a [b]6-meter[/b] area that lasts for [b]3 seconds[/b]. When it expires, it forms a [b]6-meter[/b] area that deals [b]240 000 damage[/b] over [b]120 seconds[/b]. 
[*] [h3]Wave[/h3]
Creates a [b]10-meter[/b] wide Wave that sweeps the Arena, dealing [b]5000 damage[/b] to all Incarnates it hits.
[*] [h3]Coral Burst[/h3]
Creates a [b]30-meter[/b] area that lasts for [b]8 seconds[/b]. When it expires, it forms a [b]35-meter[/b] area that deals [b]6000 damage[/b].
[*] [h3]Eggs[/h3]
Creates an Egg with [b]5000 health[/b] at a random location.

[b]Egg:[/b] After [b]15 seconds[/b], the [b]Egg [/b]is destroyed, and a Commander spawns.

Eliminating the [b]Egg[/b] deals [b]500 damage[/b] to all Incarnates and Bosses.
[*] [h3]Poison Spike[/h3]
Launch a [b]Poison Spike[/b] that deals [b]100 damage[/b] and applies [b]Infection[/b].

[b]Infection:[/b] Increases damage taken by [b]25%[/b] for [b]60 seconds[/b]. Jumping removes all stacks of [b]Infection [/b]and deals [b]500 damage[/b] to all [b]non-Protectors[/b].
[/list]

[h1]Changelog:[/h1]
[list]
[*][h2]Player Abilities[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Kinetic Conversion:[/b] Will no longer fail to launch on random occasions.
[/list]
[/list]
As always, we’d like to thank all of you who continue to provide us with valuable feedback.

We hope you enjoy these new features, and we’ll see you in the Multiverse!

notes.title: Group Finder now Live - Patch 1.01
notes.content:
Greetings Incarnates,

After some delay, the Group Finder update is finally here. 

Due to the delay, next week we will be posting an updated Roadmap.

[h1]Group Finder[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275583/0f508aead1562fa8c60c3cf679258f198ddc4569.png[/img]
Now when selecting the Coliseum game mode, if your group is incomplete, the game will offer you the option to use the Group Finder.

It will allow you to browse a list of players looking to play the same content as you. From there, you can either invite or join those players to form the perfect group.

[h1]Change Log:[/h1]
[list]
[*][h2]Player Abilities[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Inner Rage:[/b] Will now display the correct damage number.
[*][b]Soul Mass:[/b] Fixed an issue that prevented the first orb from spawning.
[*][b]Profane Grounds:[/b] Will now display the correct damage number.
[*][b]Soul Well:[/b] Will now properly give mana on the last tick.
[*][b]Echoes of Light:[/b] Will no longer break when used in combination with Soul Mass.
[*][b]Bloodletting:[/b] Will now deal the correct amount of damage.
[*][b]Cursed Strike:[/b] Effect will no longer trigger after the buff has ended.
[*][b]Kinetic Burst:[/b] Mana cost changed from 10 to 20.
[/list]
[*][h2]Coliseum[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Bosses:[/b] Will no longer spawn floating in the air.
[*][b]Comba Start:[/b] Text informing players to “press V to start fight” removed as it is no longer required.
[*][b]Announcer:[/b] Fixed an issue preventing voice over activating from the player the first time.
[/list]
[*][h2]Boss Abilities[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Levias:[/b] Will properly hold its weapon while moving and attacking.
[*][b]Eggs:[/b] Will now properly deal damage to enemies.
[*][b]Drowning Shadows:[/b] Will no longer target the Protector.
[/list]
[/list]

Thank you for continuing to provide us with useful feedback. We really appreciate it.

See you in the Multiverse!

notes.title: Early Access - Update 1
notes.content:
Greetings, Incarnates!

Today is an Update, but before going into the meat and potatoes of the subject, we have some information to share:
[list]
[*] After contacting Valve, we learned that we can no longer create and sell 4 Packs on Steam.
[*] The Group Finder feature has been delayed by a week due to a technical issue. 
[/list]
Now for the good news! In the Multiverse, you will find two new threats to contend with:
[h1]Inquisitor - Set 2[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275583/a56f886dc6584a68d5b34d5912f687bf873e9dce.png[/img]
When exploring the Multiverse, there is no guarantee that you will find yourself in the exact same location.

While familiar, this Inquisitor comes from a different timeline and has new tricks up its sleeve:
[list]
[*][h3]Lightning Storm[/h3]Apply [b]Lightning Rod[/b] to a [b]non-protector player[/b].

[b]Lightning Rod:[/b] Lasts for[b] 4 seconds[/b]; it deals [b]3000 damage[/b] to all Incarnates within [b]8 meters[/b] when it expires.
[*][h3]Acid Bomb[/h3]
Launch a bolt that deals [b]500 damage[/b] and apply an [b]Acid Bomb[/b] to the [b]Protector[/b].

[b]Acid Bomb:[/b] Lasts for [b]8 seconds[/b]; when it expires, it deals [b]12 000 damage[/b] split between all Incarnates within [b]5 meters[/b].
[*][h3]Eggs[/h3]
Creates an [b]Egg [/b]with [b]5000 health[/b] at a random location.

Egg: After [b]15 seconds[/b], the [b]Egg[/b] is destroyed, and a [b]Commander spawns[/b].

Eliminating the [b]Egg [/b]deals [b]500 damage[/b] to all Incarnates and Bosses.
[*][h3]Toxic Corals[/h3]
Creates a[b] 6-meter[/b] area that lasts for [b]3 seconds[/b]. When it expires, it forms a [b]6-meter[/b] area that deals [b]240 000 damage[/b] over [b]120 seconds[/b].
[*][h3]Drowning Shadows[/h3]
Afflicts a random [b]non-Protector[/b] with [b]Foreshadowing [/b]and[b] Glimpse of Hope[/b].

[b]Foreshadowing:[/b] Lasts for [b]8 seconds[/b]; when it expires, it creates an [b]80-meter[/b] area (Arena wide) that deals [b]12 000 damage[/b] over [b]4 seconds[/b].

[b]Glimpse of Hope:[/b] Lasts for [b]4 seconds[/b]; when it expires, it forms a [b]4-meter[/b] area that reduces [b]damage taken[/b] by[b] 100 %[/b] for [b]13 seconds[/b].
[/list]
[h1]The Heralds[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275583/dc7986ef7e4ec60a7ada37be694752e2864cf58b.png[/img]

In this fight you will be facing, not one, not two, but three enemies simultaneously.

Every time you kill a Herald, the remaining Heralds are fully healed and empowered with new abilities.

The abilities you will encounter here are:
[list]
[*][h2]Herald of Storms[/h2]
[list]
[*][h3]Weakening Ritual[/h3]
Creates a[b] 3-meter[/b] zone for [b]3 seconds[/b] at the [b]Protector's[/b] location. When the zone expires, it deals [b]2500 damage[/b] to the Incarnates in it and applies [b]Weakness[/b].

If there are no Incarnates located in this zone, it deals[b] 2000 damage[/b] to all Incarnates.

[b]Weakness:[/b] Increase[b] damage taken[/b] by [b]50 %[/b] for [b]25 seconds[/b].
[*][h3]Lightning Storm[/h3]Apply [b]Lightning Rod[/b] to a [b]non-protector player[/b].

[b]Lightning Rod:[/b] Lasts for[b] 4 seconds[/b]; it deals [b]3000 damage[/b] to all Incarnates within [b]8 meters[/b] when it expires.
[*][h3]Drowning Shadows[/h3]
Afflicts a random [b]non-Protector[/b] with [b]Foreshadowing [/b]and[b] Glimpse of Hope[/b].

[b]Foreshadowing:[/b] Lasts for [b]8 seconds[/b]; when it expires, it creates an [b]80-meter[/b] area (Arena wide) that deals [b]12 000 damage[/b] over [b]4 seconds[/b].

[b]Glimpse of Hope:[/b] Lasts for [b]4 seconds[/b]; when it expires, it forms a [b]4-meter[/b] area that reduces [b]damage taken[/b] by[b] 100 %[/b] for [b]13 seconds[/b].
[/list]
[*][h2]Herald of Toxins[/h2]
[list]
[*][h3]Acid Bomb[/h3]
Launch a bolt that deals [b]500 damage[/b] and apply an [b]Acid Bomb[/b] to the [b]Protector[/b].

[b]Acid Bomb:[/b] Lasts for [b]8 seconds[/b]; when it expires, it deals [b]12 000[/b] damage split between all Incarnates within [b]5 meters[/b].
[*][h3]Acid Rain[/h3]
Creates a[b] 4-meter[/b] area for [b]3 seconds[/b] at all Incarnates' locations. When it expires, it deals [b]3000 damage[/b] to all Incarnates standing in the area.
[*][h3]Bubbling Acid[/h3]
Launch a projectile that applies[b] Bubbling Acid[/b] to a random [b]non-Protector[/b]. 

[b]Bubbling Acid:[/b] Deals[b] 500 damage[/b] over [b]10 seconds[/b]. If it deals damage while you're moving, it also deals [b]500 damage[/b] to all Incarnates.
[/list]
[*][h2]Herald of Waves[/h2]
[list]
[*][h3]Curse of Servitude[/h3]
Every [b]basic attack[/b] will apply [b]Curse of Servitude[/b].

[b]Curse of Servitude:[/b] Increases [b]damage taken[/b] by [b]4%[/b] and grants the[b] Submit[/b] ability.

[b]Submit ("Shift + LMB"):[/b] Remove all [b]Curses of Servitude[/b] and deals [b]1000 damage[/b] to all Incarnates.
[*][h3]Cursed Water[/h3]
Creates a [b]6-meter[/b] area that lasts for [b]3 seconds[/b]. When it expires, it forms a [b]6-meter[/b] area that deals [b]240 000 damage[/b] over[b] 120 seconds[/b].
[*][h3]Eggs[/h3]
Creates an [b]Egg[/b] with [b]5000 health[/b] at a random location.

[b]Egg:[/b] After [b]15 seconds[/b], the [b]Egg[/b] is destroyed, and a [b]Commander spawns[/b].

Eliminating the [b]Egg [/b]deals [b]500[/b] damage to all Incarnates and Bosses.
[/list]
[/list]
[h1]Changelog[/h1]
[h2]Player Abilities[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Bloodletting:[/b] Damage over time reduced from 200 to 40. 
[*][b]Cursed Strike:[/b] Visual Effects has been changed to look less like an enemy area.
[*][b]Frenzy:[/b] Fix an issue that prevents the player from using it more than once.
[*][b]Echoes of Light:[/b]Visual Effects should properly despawn when used.
[/list]
[h2]Boss Abilities[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Bubbling Acid:[/b] Will no longer incorrectly target the Protector.
[*][b]Eggs:[/b] Should now properly deal damage to enemies when destroyed.
[*][b]Acid Bomb:[/b] Visual Effects should now be properly timed with the detonation.
[*][b]Coral Burst:[/b]Sound Effects should now be properly timed.
[/list]
[h2]General[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Player Hub:[/b] Fixed several graphical issues (thanks to RedDot for reporting them).
[*][b]UI:[/b] Improved icons to properly stack when relevant. 
[/list]

Big thanks again to everyone who took the time to provide us feedback, and we hope to see you in the Multiverse!

notes.title: Roadmap - Phase 1
notes.content:
Now that the Early Access version of ASCENDANTS Rising has been released, we have planned a steady stream of updates for the game.

Our current plan is to alternate between updates, which will bring new content, and patches, which will focus on bug fixes.

This week will feature our first Early Access patch; we will provide a full changelog tomorrow.
 
As we develop the new features, we will also try to share some previews as often as possible.

Please note that dates are subject to change based on feedback from players and bug fixing.

Here is the roadmap for the following 3 Updates.
[h1]Update 1 (July 8):[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275583/8eb1db183e4d72f77ff3ccd0e900b7f2d9d18117.png[/img]
[h2]New Boss! - The Heralds[/h2]
The Heralds join the battle! 

In these fights, you will be facing three different Heralds at the same time. 

Heralds come in five different flavors: Waves, Toxins, Storms, Corals, and Ice.

The first three Heralds available to fight will be the Heralds of Waves, Toxins, and Storms.

Every time you defeat a Herald, the remaining Heralds are fully healed and empowered with new abilities.
[h2]New Feature! - Group Finder[/h2]
The group finder is a new feature that will allow you to search for players or groups to join.

Whenever you select a game, if your group is incomplete or you are alone, the game will offer you the possibility to list yourself on the group finder.

This will allow you to join another group or invite people to your group.
[h1]Update 2 (July 22):[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275583/3a9e42b2ac9c26e92cda9e9df892764caaa897fc.png[/img]
[h2]New Boss! - Hydra[/h2]
The Hydras come from below to end your existence.

You face two unique Hydra heads at once, but two new ones will pop out for every head you cut off. You will need to persevere until this Boss cannot generate new heads.

[h2]New Feature! - Extend Info Screen[/h2]
With this feature, by holding TAB during a mission, you will be able to open two windows with additional information.

On the left, you will be able to read the current Boss's abilities and mechanics. On the right, you will be able to see a description of your abilities.

[h2]New Artefact! - Soul Drain Catalyst[/h2]
The Soul Drain Catalyst is the perfect Artefact for those that know how to master the flow of a Boss battle.

Soul Drain is a channeled ability that increases the damage it deals and mana it generates the longer you have it active.

The signature ability, Giga Drain, allows you to cast a more powerful version of the ability for 2 seconds. Managing to hold it for the entire duration will yield incredible amounts of damage and mana.

[h1]Update 3 (August 5):[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275583/350e891773c255ae6f1c911b9b8d728dfb67e4eb.png[/img]
[h2]New Feature! - Group Chat[/h2]
This feature will allow you to chat with your teammates and coordinate a flawless victory or, of course, blame the hunter for pulling an extra pack of mobs.

[h2]New Boss! - The Maw[/h2]
The Maw is a fleshy abomination with a massive appetite, and it's on the hunt for its next meal. We have the pleasure of letting you know you have been personally selected for its dinner.

While the Maw cannot move, it will unleash an onslaught of abilities against you, which continuously speed up.

The good news is that you can slow down its frenzy by feeding it; the bad news is that the only food available is you. 

An extra action button will allow you to jump in the Maw to appease its frenzy. Luckily for you, after years of gorging, its jaw is too bloated to close, presenting you with a convenient escape route once you are done pretending to be an appetizer.

[h2]New Ability Set! - The Alchemist Set[/h2]
A new set of abilities themed around a Steampunk Asian Alchemist. 

To make the most out of these new abilities, you will have to combine different spells to trigger powerful additional effects. 

This set of abilities will reward players that like to plan and scheme their next move.

[h1]More Boss sets[/h1]
Any update will potentially come with new Boss sets. However, Boss sets are not part of the roadmap, as their exact release date is too volatile.

[h2]What are Boss sets?[/h2]
In the end, each Boss will have five possible variations. Their core behavior is the same. However, the ability they will use is going to be different.

These Boss variations will also slightly alter their appearances. 

[h1]The 4-Pack[/h1]
We will also create a new 4-Pack in the store, allowing you to purchase four copies of the game with a 40% price discount.

A big thank you to everyone who supports us while we develop ASCENDANTS Rising in Early Access.

See you in the Multiverse!

notes.title: Early Access - Hotfix 1
notes.content:
Greetings Incarnates,

Today we have release a quick hotfix containing the following:
[list]
[*] Developers tools are no longer available in release.
[*] Removed the invalid dungeon game mode.
[*] Game version is now properly set as a release build which should translate to better optimization.
[/list]

We would like to mention that a group finder tool is also on its way which will allow you to find other players and form groups from inside the game.

Beginning next week we will communicate a timeline on when this feature will be available.

On a meanwhile we will put a post explaining how to find players on steam forums.

Thanks to everyone that choose to support us so far.

notes.title: Closed Beta - Update 2
notes.content:
Greetings Incarnates,

This week in the Multiverse, you will be able to find two new Bosses, a new Artefact, Legendaries Outfits, and more!

Before going into more details about the update, note that you can find a small Press Pack here: LINK

[h1]New Content:[/h1]

[h2]New Artefact - Energy Axe and Shield[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275583/e516ef982b11c9653941a7a6120e0c0a70de7685.png[/img]
The Energy Axe and Shield are now available to test. This Artefact is ideal for fights where you frequently take damage:
[list]
[*][h3]Axe Swing[/h3]
Deals [b]500 damage[/b] to enemies in front of you.

Generates[b] 5 mana[/b] if an enemy is hit.
[*][h3]Shield Burst[/h3]
Deals [b]1000 damage[/b] in the shape of a cone in front of you and consumes any [b]Revenge [/b]stack you have, dealing [b]50 additional damage[/b] per stack. 

[b]Passive[/b]: Taking damage grants a stack of [b]Revenge[/b]. You can have up to [b]20 stack[/b]. 

Generates [b]15 mana [/b]if a target is hit.
[/list]
[h2]The Inquisitor[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275583/1f707e1c13383f7657836a84c3da369418f3a1c2.png[/img]
Making his debuts in the Coliseum, we have the Inquisitor.

This fight is split into two alternating phases: 

[list]
[*][h3][b]Main Phase: [/b][/h3]During this phase you directly fights the Inquisitor. He will have the following abilities:
[list]
[*][h3]Curse of Servitude[/h3]
Every [b]basic attack[/b] will apply [b]Curse of Servitude[/b].

[b]Curse of Servitude:[/b] Increases [b]damage taken[/b] by[b] 4%[/b] and grants the [b]Submit [/b]ability.

[b]Submit ("Shift+LMB"):[/b] Remove all [b]Curses of Servitude[/b] and deals[b] 1000 damage[/b] to all Incarnates.
[*][h3]Poison Spike[/h3]
Launch a [b]Poison Spike[/b] that deals [b]100 damage[/b] and applies[b] Infection[/b].

[b]Infection[/b]: [b]Increases taken[/b] by [b]25% for 60 seconds[/b]. [b]Jumping [/b]
removes all stacks of Infection and deals [b]500 damage[/b] to all Incarnates.
[*][h3]Acid Rain[/h3]
Creates a [b]4-meter[/b] area for [b]3 seconds[/b] at all Incarnates' locations. When it expires, it deals [b]3000 damage[/b] to all Incarnates standing in the area.
[/list]
[*][h3] [b]Egg Phase:[/b] [/h3] At two different Health Threshold, the Inquisitor will hide inside a giant Egg to evolve himself.

The Incarnates will have to destroy the Egg as fast as possible. Every second he spends inside increases the damage he deals for the reminder of the fights.

Which each new Egg he will gain new abilities:
[list]
[*][h3] Poison Bomb (Egg Phase 1): [/h3] 
Creates a[b] Poison Orb[/b] with [b]5000 health[/b] that lasts for [b]25 seconds[/b].

Every[b] 8 seconds[/b], the [b]Poison Orb[/b] deals [b]3000 damage[/b] to all Incarnates.
[*][h3] Coral Burst(Egg Phase 2): [/h3] 
Creates a [b]30-meter[/b] area that lasts for [b]8 seconds[/b]. When it expires, it creates an [b]30-meter[/b] area that deals [b]6000 damage.[/b]
[/list]
[/list]
[h2]Cetus and Levias[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275583/db030d9365627fd6a64b7d61ff80cb0997f514db.png[/img]
While Levias starts alone on the platforms, he will quickly call Cetus for Help.

You will have to deal with those two threats simultaneously, and killing one before the other will make them Enrage.

Each of them has different set of Abilities:
[list]
[*][h3][b]Levias[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*][h3]Acid Bomb[/h3]
Launch a bolt that deals[b] 500 damage[/b] and apply an [b]Acid Bomb[/b] to the Protector.

[b]Acid Bomb[/b]: Lasts for [b]8 seconds[/b]; when it expires, it deals[b] 16 000[/b] damage split between all Incarnates within [b]5 meters[/b].
[*][h3]Bubbling Acid[/h3]
Launch a projectile that applies [b]Bubbling Acid[/b] to a random non-Protector Incarnate. 

[b]Bubbling Acid:[/b] Deals [b]500 damage[/b] over [b]10 seconds[/b]. If it deals damage while you're [b]moving[/b], it also deals [b]500 damage[/b] to all Incarnates.
[/list]
[*][h3][b]Cetus[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*][h3]Eggs[/h3]
Creates an [b]Egg [/b]with [b]5000 health[/b] at a random location.

[b]Egg:[/b] After [b]15 seconds[/b], the [b]Egg [/b]is destroyed, and a [b]Commander [/b]is spawned.

Destroying the [b]Egg [/b]deals [b]500 damage[/b] to all Incarnates and the Bosses.
[*][h3]Wave[/h3]
Create a [b]10-meter [/b]wide Wave that sweeps the Arena, dealing[b] 5000 damage[/b] to all Incarnates it hits.
[/list]
[/list]

[h2]Outfits and Legendary Variants [/h2]
In Ascendants Rising, Players will be able to customize their characters with outfits.

Most Outfits will be unlocked through progression or achievements. Your first unlocks will be the Incarnate Officers Set:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275583/4f9112b4f0100e1fddbfdf61018e23d95d976db1.png[/img]
Each outfit's sets will have a Legendary variant. Legendaries are usually earned through challenges inside the game.

However, the first set is a gift from us for anyone that participates in the Early Access.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275583/9556ecc625d718d97e7c027f25e852fee2053e83.png[/img]
Here is also a sneak peak as to what the next set will look like:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275583/d5f031b7076c418bf835f70d3906d0f61c02ef52.png[/img]
[h2]Changelog:[/h2]
[list]
[*][h3]Player Abilities[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]New Artefact:[/b] Axe and Shield.
[*] [b]Resonance:[/b] Cooldown has been removed.
[*] [b]Soul Keeper:[/b] Will no longer hit a target out of range.
[*] [b]Soul Mass:[/b] Will now correctly generate orbs.
[*] [b]Dash n Slash:[/b] Will no longer improperly hit the target twice.
[*] [b]Revolver Shot:[/b] Fixed an issue that sometimes stopped it from firing.
[*] [b]Visual Effects:[/b] Will now correctly despawn on a wipe.
[*] [b]Visual Effects:[/b] An overall pass has been made to improve readability during combat.
[/list]
[*][h3]Coliseum[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]New Boss!:[/b]  The InquisItor
[*][b]New Boss!:[/b]  Levias and Cetus
[*][b]General:[/b] Bosses should now spawn faster.
[*][b]Frost Golem:[/b] Will now spawn properly on the ground.
[*][b]Weakening Ritual:[/b] Effect will now last the intended duration.
[*][b]Enrage:[/b] Boss enrage visual effects has been added.
[/list]
[*][h3]Tutorial[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Performance:[/b] An optimization pass has been made; this should lead to an increased or more stable framerate.
[*][b]Environment:[/b] Projectiles are no longer able to go through walls.
[*][b]Balance:[/b] Enemy minions damage has been reduced.
[*][b]Frost Golem:[/b] Frost Golem will be able to use the Wave ability.
[*][b]Voice Over:[/b] Some disparities with the audio should have been fixed.
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: Closed Beta - Update 1
notes.content:
Greetings Incarnates, 

We are very excited to release this first update for the Closed Beta, and we want to thank everybody who took the time to provide us with feedback.

With this update, we want to shift the testing focus to the Coliseum.

[h2][b]With this update, you will find:[/b][/h2]

[h2]The Coliseum:[/h2]

In the Coliseum, Incarnates fight to prove themselves worthy.

This is a 4 Player Game Mode where you will be facing a series of 3 randomized Bosses.

You will need to assemble a team including 1 Protector, 1 Healer, and 2 Strikers to prevail.

To access the Coliseum, a new temporary “Sessions” Test Menu has been made available. From there, you can create a Coliseum test server for 4 players.

[b]Note that the test servers will only start once 4 players have joined.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275583/7c7471df70c0b0174a221787aac9329440de2153.png[/img]

[h2]Frost Golem[/h2]

For this first testing session, your only adversary will be the Frost Golem.

As we move forward, in the next update, we will add new Bosses and swap which enemies are available for testing in the Coliseum.

The Frost Golem is your run-of-the-mill starting Boss. It is meant to be simple to understand while offering a substantial challenge.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275583/353d7f271501a1a448fc5d2f8e86639bf2ba35d2.png[/img]

[h2]Frost Golem Abilities:[/h2]
[list]
[*][h3]Weakening Ritual[/h3]
Creates an [b]3 meter[/b] zone for[b] 3 seconds[/b] at the tank's location. When the zone expires, it deals[b] 2500 damage[/b] to the player in it and applies [b]Weakness[/b].

If there are no players located in this zone, it deals [b]3000 damage[/b] to all players.

[b]Weakness: [/b]Increase [b]damage taken[/b] by [b]50%[/b] for [b]30 Seconds[/b].
[*][h3]Cursed Water[/h3]
Launch a projectile that applies [b]Cursed Waters[/b].

[b]Cursed Waters:[/b] Last for [b]6 seconds[/b]; when it expires, it creates an[b] 8 mete[/b]r area at the location for [b]3 seconds[/b].

When that zone expires, it creates an [b]8 meter[/b] area that deals [b]240 000 damage[/b] over [b]120 seconds[/b].
[*][h3]Wave[/h3]
Create an [b]10 meter[/b] wide [b]Wave [/b]that sweeps the Arena, dealing [b]5000 damage [/b] to players it impacts.
[*][h3]Toxic Corals[/h3]
Creates an [b]8 meter[/b] area that lasts for[b] 3 seconds[/b]. When it expires, it creates an [b]8 meter[/b] area that deals [b]240 000 damage[/b] over [b]120 seconds[/b].
[*][h3]Snowstorm[/h3] 
An [b]arena wide area[/b] that deals[b] 100 damage[/b] every [b]3 seconds[/b]. 

If there are no allies within [b]4 meters [/b]of you, you take additional [b]100 damage[/b].
[/list]

To emerge victorious against the Frost Golem, your team’s placement will be key.

[h2]Bug Fixes and Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Players will no longer be obligated to link their Steam account to an Epic account.
[*] Steam VR should no longer launch when trying to play the game.
[*] Advanced Tutorial enemy damage lowered to appropriate levels.
[/list]
[h2]Providing Feedback:
[/h2]

If after slaying the Frost Golem you have time to provide some feedback, here are a few questions that we would be grateful if you could answer:
[list]
[*]What did you think about the Coliseum environment?
[*]How did you feel your role impacted the fight (Protector, Striker, or Healer)?
[*]Were there some Enemy Abilities that were hard to understand or read?
[*]How fast did you kill the Boss, and how did you feel about the length of the fights?
[/list]
As usual, the Steam Forums are the place for you to submit feedback, but you are also welcome to share your thoughts with us on our Discord: https://discord.gg/2uNp4th

Thank you, and see you in the Multiverse!
